blocks.text: אֶתֵּן לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. בַּיּוֹם הַנִּבְחַר מַעַשׂ לְהִבָּדֵק: גַּאֲוָתוֹ מְאֹד גָּדְלָה. דֶּרֶךְ עֲנָוָתוֹ לְפִי הַגְּדֻלָּה: הוּא אֲדוֹן הָעוֹלָם. וּמִי הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם: זוֹכֵר הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם. חוֹנֵן וְעוֹשֶׂה דִּין יָתוֹם: טָהוֹר מָרוֹם וְנִשָּׂא. יָפֶה בְּעִתּוֹ הַכֹּל עָשָׂה: כַּבִּיר לֹא יִמְאַס. לְנִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס: מְפֹאָר רוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת. נֹגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת: סוֹעֵף בַּחֲרָבוֹת שְׁנוּנוֹת. עֲבוּר יְתוֹמִים וְאַלְמָנוֹת: פֹּעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֵּם. צָר פֶּה וּמֵשִׂים אִלֵּם: קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים. רָם, וּמַשְׁפִּיל רָמִים: שׁוֹפֵט יְצוּרָיו בַּחֲנִינָה. תְּמִים פֹּעַל אֵל אֱמוּנָה: שׁוֹפְטֵי אֶרֶץ כַּתֹּהוּ. מִפַּחְדּוֹ יִבְהֲלוּ וְיִתְמָהוּ: עוֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ. וּתְחִלָּה מְקַדְּמָם מִפְּנֵי זַעְמוֹ: נְדִיבִים בְּדִקְדּוּקָם יָחִילוּ. בַּאֲשֶׁר מִשְׁפָּטוֹ פָּעֲלוּ: רוֹאֶה כָּל־תַּעֲלוּמוֹת. יוֹשֵׁב בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמוֹת: צוֹפֶה כָּל נוֹלָדוֹת. חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל הָעֲתִידוֹת: קוֹרֵא הַדּוֹרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ. חִקְרֵי לֵב לָתוּר וְלִדְרוֹשׁ:

blocks.text: אתן

I praise the justice of my Creator on the day appointed for the examination of deeds. His majesty is great, but the way of His humility accords with His greatness. He is Lord of the world, who can resist Him and remain unharmed? He remembers the man who walks in uprightness, and graciously promotes the cause of the orphan. Pure, lofty and exalted, He has made everything harmoniously in its time. Although Almighty, He does not reject the man who in his own eyes is despised and rejected. Glorified, riding above the clouds, radiance is in front of Him and blazing fire. He rages with sharp swords on behalf of orphans and widows. He requites man according to his work. He shapes the mouth and also makes it dumb. Owner of all in compassion, He is lofty and lowers the lofty. He judges His creatures with clemency, perfect in action, God of faithfulness. Earthly judges are as nought, they are frightened through dread of Him and perplexed. He executes the judgment of His people, warning them first of His wrath. Noble ones tremble at the thought of their judgment, as to whether they have accomplished His law. He sees all that are hidden, He dwells in the loftiest heights. He perceives all that is happening, He explores all that is about to come. He summons the generations from the very beginning in order to search out and discover the thoughts of their hearts. O Thou who dost remember the covenant with those who came first, fulfil the promise to those who come last.
uncertainties: The English has no separate paragraph or speaker mark for זוכר ברית; its translation ('O Thou who dost remember the covenant…') runs on at the end of this paragraph
'per-plexed' is hyphenated across a line break in print; joined here as 'perplexed'

notes: s140 and s141 are not page 124/125, so both pages were read in full. The Hebrew at the top of s140, above the rule, continues the piyyut from the previous page and ends with the תשלש / מלך זוכר refrains. Below the rule is the Sabbath alternative piyyut אתן לפועלי.
Printed conditional alternative: the rule plus the Hebrew rubric (English: 'On Sabbath.') marks אתן לפועלי … זוכר ברית … ישפוט as the Sabbath option.

Acrostic: the hemistich openings of אתן לפועלי run through the alphabet (א אתן, ג גאותו, ה הוא, ז זוכר, ח חונן, ט טהור, י יפה, כ כביר, ל לנבזה, מ מפאר, נ נגה, ס סועף, ע עבור, פ פעל, צ צר, ק קונה, ר רם, ש שופט, ת תמים). The alternate hemistichs and the second series (שופטי, מפחדו, עושה, ותחלה, נדיבים, באשר, רואה, יושב, צופה, חופש, קורא, חקרי) are not alphabetical, so they may carry a name acrostic. Not printed on the page; this is my observation.

No Rashi-script attribution or author note was seen on either page beyond the two small rubrics. Recitation roles are marked only by the קו״ח siglum (most likely 'congregation and cantor'; reading not confirmed) before תשלש and זוכר ברית.

Proposed corrections, kept separate from the literal text: קוֹנֵה → קוֹנֶה (expected segol); the tune rubric probably reads בנגון אאפיד (the כ/ב confusion is likely in Rashi-style type). Neither is certain.
